# Replication Product Example {#sec-walker-replication-product}

Once you've worked through importing, processing, and (eventually) analyzing the Walker et al. (2023) data, your final product should look something like the deck below. It's a full worked example: the motivation, the data, the econometric approach, the results (including a side-by-side comparison against Walker et al.'s own numbers), limitations, future directions, and the actual code that produced it.

This isn't a template to copy line-for-line — your own replication will differ in the details — but it's meant to give you a concrete sense of what "finished" looks like.
